capabilities: Render and play Guitar Pro files (.gp, .gp3-.gpx) with playback cursor, auto-scroll and metronome
Write scores in alphaTex via .atex files or alphatex code blocks with syntax highlighting
Export tabs as Guitar Pro files, PNG share cards, or PDF via print preview
Learn alphaTex in a built-in documentation view and playground
Edit and preview scores side by side in the alphaTex editor
disambiguation: Not a browser-tab or workspace manager; 'tabs' here means guitar tablature scores.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.8.0+); runtime assets (music font, soundfont, web worker) must be downloaded once from the plugin settings; install via BRAT recommended while the plugin is in review; PDF export and share feature are beta/work in progress; some Guitar Pro scores render imperfectly due to CJK text encoding.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or play Guitar Pro tablature files, and has no way to write, preview or export tab notation in notes.

relations.evidence: Render, play and write guitar tabs in Obsidian. Powered by alphaTab.

summary: Guitar tab toolkit that renders and plays Guitar Pro files and lets you write, preview and share alphaTex scores inside Obsidian.
